info.name: ThingsAlive NeoX — Supabase REST API
info.description:
Full Supabase PostgREST API surface for the ThingsAlive NeoX ERP app (React + Supabase, no custom backend). Covers Auth, every table (89) with List/Get/Create/Update/Delete via PostgREST, the next_sequence RPC, and the invoices storage bucket. Field names were extracted directly from the app source (insert/update call sites) and sql/*.sql CREATE TABLE statements — not guessed. Tables marked READ ONLY have no known write path in the app itself; use with care.

Setup: import the companion environment, fill in SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY from your .env, then run "Auth > Sign In (password)" once — its Tests script auto-saves ACCESS_TOKEN/REFRESH_TOKEN/USER_ID for every other request.

request.description: Maps to supabase.auth.signUp({email, password, options:{data: meta}}) in src/context/AuthContext.jsx. The profiles row is created separately by a DB trigger keyed on the new auth user id.

request.description: Maps to supabase.auth.signInWithPassword(). Run this first — the Tests script saves ACCESS_TOKEN/REFRESH_TOKEN/USER_ID into the environment for every other request in this collection.
